rules: The retained primary must visibly identify the canonical building and have a traceable open-license chain.
A generic or unrelated Unsplash image is demoted only after the replacement identity and license are reviewed.
Modern architecture in a no-freedom-of-panorama jurisdiction is deferred when the license does not resolve the architectural copyright risk.
Public-domain claims with an incomplete United States basis are deferred.
No production write is authorized until the isolated PostgreSQL dry-run and fresh production conflict precheck pass.

decisions.reason: The Commons photo identifies the Florence shopping center, but Italy does not provide Wikimedia-compatible freedom of panorama for this modern Mario Botta work. The photographic CC BY 3.0 statement does not by itself resolve the architectural copyright risk.

The 1926 photograph identifies the listed clubhouse, but Commons warns that the anonymous French public-domain claim lacks a United States public-domain tag. The source and author history are not strong enough for promotion.

decisions.visual_finding: The Commons image shows the long white International Modern facade at 64 Old Church Street. The Unsplash image shows an unrelated contemporary religious building.

identity_evidence.claim: Historic England identifies 64 Old Church Street as the 1936 Mendelsohn and Chermayeff house and describes the same street facade.

decisions.visual_finding: The upper half of the 1941 government guide page explicitly labels and shows Richard Neutra's Experimental Public School. The Unsplash image is an unrelated concrete interior.

identity_evidence.claim: The Getty identifies Corona Avenue School in Bell as Richard Neutra's 1935 open-air school and documents its lawn-facing classrooms.

decisions.visual_finding: The LOC/FSA photograph shows the Dymaxion House interior and its circular openings. The Unsplash image is an unrelated dark room with an oculus.

identity_evidence.claim: The Library of Congress record identifies the photographed metal Dymaxion House, R. Buckminster Fuller and Marion Post Wolcott.

retained_file_evidence.license_basis: FSA/OWI employee work created as part of official duties

verification.commons_method: Wikimedia Commons API imageinfo with url, 500px thumbnail and extmetadata
